# Set-Up

```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(biscale)
library(patchwork)
```

## Project Specific Functions

```{r}
source("03_scripts/01_functions.R")
```

## Plotting Defaults

```{r}
theme_set(theme_bw())
```


# Import Data

## RTS

```{r}
rts_pt <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_pt.geojson")
rts_poly <- st_read("./01_processed_data/high_prob_rts_poly.geojson")
```

## RTS Probability

```{r}
rts_prob <- rast(
  '../rts_rep_analysis/sdm/gbm_kfold_10_pred_tuned_median_v.3.1.0_filter.tif'
) |>
  project(vect(rts_pt))
```

## Domain

```{r}
domain <- st_read("./01_processed_data/domain_south_clean.geojson")
hex_domains <- list.files(
  "./01_processed_data",
  pattern = "hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k_domain.geojson",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  str_sort(decreasing = TRUE, numeric = TRUE)

hex_names <- map(
  hex_domains,
  ~ .x |> str_extract("hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k")
)

hex_domains <- map(
  hex_domains,
  ~ st_read(.x)
)

names(hex_domains) <- hex_names
```

## Hex Grids

```{r}
hex_grids <- list.files(
  "./01_processed_data",
  pattern = "hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k.geojson",
  full.names = TRUE
) |>
  str_sort(decreasing = TRUE, numeric = TRUE)

hex_names <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ .x |> str_extract("hex_grid_\\d{2,3}k")
)

hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ st_read(.x)
)

names(hex_grids) <- hex_names
rm(hex_names)
```

## NaturalEarth

```{r}
world <- rnaturalearth::ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf") |>
  select(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
```

```{r}
crop_poly <- tibble(
  geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(0, 90)), crs = 'EPSG:4326')
) %>%
  st_sf() %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt)) %>%
  st_buffer(dist = 5250000) %>%
  smoothr::densify(n = 3) %>%
  st_transform(crs = 'EPSG:4326')

crop_bbox <- crop_poly |>
  st_transform(6931) |>
  st_bbox()

long_lines <- seq(-180, 180, by = 60) %>%
  map(
    ~ long_lines_from_coords(.x, lat_min = st_bbox(crop_poly)[2], lat_max = 90)
  ) %>%
  bind_rows()

lat_lines <- seq(50, 90, by = 10) %>%
  map(~ lat_lines_from_coords(.x, lon_min = -180, lon_max = 180)) %>%
  bind_rows()
```

```{r}
russia <- world |>
  filter(name == "Russia") |>
  st_cast("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(id = 1:n())

# West Wrangell Island is 29, East Wrangell Island is 31
russia$geometry[29] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[29], dist = 0.11)
russia$geometry[31] <- fix_geometry_at_origin(russia$geometry[31], dist = 0.11)

russia <- russia |>
  select(-id)

russia <- russia |>
  summarise(
    geometry = st_union(russia),
    .by = c(name, continent, region_un, subregion)
  )

world <- world |>
  filter(name != "Russia") |>
  rbind(russia)


world_north <- world %>%
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_intersection(crop_poly) %>%
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(rts_pt))
```

# Extract RTS Probability in Hex Grid

```{r}
hex_grids <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ terra::extract(
    rts_prob,
    .x,
    fun = max,
    na.rm = TRUE,
    ID = FALSE,
    bind = TRUE
  ) |>
    st_as_sf() |>
    mutate(
      rts_prob = case_when(
        !is.nan(median) ~ median,
        TRUE ~ NA
      )
    ) |>
    select(-median)
)
```

```{r}
map(
  hex_grids,
  function(.x) {
    # RTS Count (Modeled)
    ggplot(data = .x) +
      geom_histogram(aes(x = rts_prob))
  }
)
```

```{r}
count_breaks <- map(
  hex_grids,
  ~ list(
    "rts_modeled_count" = rgeoda::natural_breaks(5, .x["rts_modeled_count"]),
    "rts_prob" = rgeoda::natural_breaks(5, .x["rts_prob"])
  )
)

manual_breaks_rts_count <- list(
  "manual_breaks_100k" = c(0, 10, 100, 1000),
  "manual_breaks_50k" = c(0, 5, 50, 500),
  "manual_breaks_10k" = c(0, 1, 10, 100)
)

manual_breaks_rts_prob <- c(0, 25, 50, 75)
```

```{r}
hex_grids <- map2(
  hex_grids,
  manual_breaks_rts_count,
  ~ .x |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      bi_class_prob = str_flatten(
        c(
          classify_counts(rts_modeled_count, breaks = .y),
          classify_counts(rts_prob, breaks = manual_breaks_rts_prob)
        ),
        collapse = "-"
      ),
      .before = geometry
    ) |>
    ungroup()
)
```


# Map

## Bivariate Maps
Compare modeled RTS counts to ARTS

```{r}
custom_palette_5 <- c(
  "1-1" = "#FFFFFF",
  "2-1" = "#FFDCD5",
  "3-1" = "#FBB8AC",
  "4-1" = "#F39585",
  "5-1" = "#E8705F",
  "1-2" = "#D4DFEF",
  "2-2" = "#D6BDC5",
  "3-2" = "#D39B9D",
  "4-2" = "#CC7877",
  "5-2" = "#C15552",
  "1-3" = "#A8C0DF",
  "2-3" = "#AD9FB6",
  "3-3" = "#AC7E8F",
  "4-3" = "#A65D69",
  "5-3" = "#9C3A46",
  "1-4" = "#7AA2CE",
  "2-4" = "#8482A6",
  "3-4" = "#856380",
  "4-4" = "#81435B",
  "5-4" = "#781F3A",
  "1-5" = "#4385BE",

```

Redder colors indicate more RTS were mapped than predicted, while bluer colors indicate fewer RTS were mapped than predicted.

```{r}
bi_legend_location <- c(
  left = 0.81,
  bottom = 0,
  right = 1,
  top = 0.145
)

hex_maps_bi <- pmap(
  list(hex_grids, hex_domains, manual_breaks_rts_count),
  function(grid, domain, breaks) {
    filtered_grid <- grid |>
      filter(!is.na(bi_class_prob))

    map_hex_grid_bi(
      filtered_grid,
      "bi_class_prob",
      "rts_modeled_count",
      "rts_prob",
      domain,
      5,
      breaks,
      manual_breaks_rts_prob,
      custom_palette_5,
      legend_loc = bi_legend_location,
      xlab = "RTS Count (Modeled)",
      ylab = "RTS Probability"
    )
  }
)

hex_maps_bi
```
